issue_title: [Perf] next_id uses O(n) max() scan on every add operation

implementation.approach: Lazy initialization with persistent max_id caching
implementation.description: Replaced O(n) max() scan per add with O(1) cached increment. The max_id is computed once (lazily on first call) and then simply incremented on subsequent calls, eliminating the O(n) scan on every add operation.

risks.description: If a different list with higher IDs is passed to the same storage instance, ID collisions could occur
risks.mitigation: This is not a realistic use case; in practice, each storage instance works with its associated data file
